requirements.title: F, E, EN, ES, EX, and D edit real and complex data only
requirements.definition: F, E, EN, ES, EX, and D edit real and complex data, and the corresponding effective item shall be real or complex; G/B/O/Z can also edit real and complex data as specified elsewhere.

pending.real-family-edit-real-complex: Internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,F5.1)') -3.0 to character(len=5) expects exactly buf=' -3.0'.
pending.real-family-effective-item-type: Source-control only: F editing of an integer item differs from a conforming I edit only by effective-item type; no required diagnostic facet is filed for this unnumbered prose restriction.
pending.real-complex-may-use-GBOZ: B/O/Z real/complex bit-sequence behavior is accounted in 13.7.2.4; G real/complex behavior is deferred to sibling 13.7.5.2.3.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans use independent literal expected strings, integer sentinels, or scalar state checks. Negative/source-control plans change one property from a conforming control and are not treated as diagnostic facets unless this unit itself requires rejection.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Pending output plans use internal WRITE to a CHARACTER variable where possible and name exact expected characters including blanks. Plans that rely on real approximation, optional signs, D/E exponent-letter alternatives, EX binary-exponent selection, IEEE NaN payloads, Unicode/non-Unicode files, list-directed input/output, stream positioning, or unregistered 13.8 mode descriptors are marked deferred or processor-dependent rather than asserted. Unnumbered prose restrictions are not promoted to numbered-constraint diagnostics.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: 13.1-13.4 for format specifications, edit descriptors, fields, and format-control interaction; clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, and 11 for source form, labels, names, character values, expressions, arrays, and executable constructs; registered clause 7 catalogues where already present for signed-digit strings, significands, BOZ literal digits, and type concepts. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: clause 12 I/O statements, file connection, internal/external files, list-directed I/O, and ROUND=/DECIMAL= controls; sibling 13.7.3-13.9 for character/logical/G editing and control/mode descriptors; sibling 13.10-13.11 for remaining format features; clause 15 for defined I/O; clause 16 for IEEE and inquiry intrinsics in future fixtures; clause 17 for IEEE rounding/exceptional values; and clauses 3, 5, 14, and 19 where future fixtures need terms, constants, programs, or scope rules.

review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review, three rounds: doc/source_audits/batch_137.json. The reviewer re-derived unit hashes and read Tables 13.1, 13.2 and 13.3 ROW BY ROW against the PDF, independently of the author's reconstruction - necessary because extraction interleaved the columns and every future E/EN/ES fixture derives from those rows. THREE blocking findings. The integrator found the first directly: two sample plans gave a NEGATIVE result for the POSITIVE input 0.5, but SS suppresses the optional plus so the sign position must be BLANK - corrected to ' 500.000E-03' and '   5.000E-01', hand-derived and corroborated with gfortran. C137SR-001: ELEVEN units mixing an obligation with a grant of latitude were dispositioned wholly as permission - the fourth occurrence of that class this session - and were re-dispositioned to requirements with the latitude confined to rationale and oracle text; the reviewer confirmed no latitude is now wrongly asserted as an obligation. C137SR-002: placeholder plans remained, saying things like 'future plan must include exact output'; 48 entries were changed, 21 upgraded to exact executable strings and 27 marked explicitly unassertable, and the reviewer independently derived the scale-factor cases -1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 0.010E+02' and 1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 1.000E+00'. R1323 carries no diagnostic facet because it defines a hex-digit-string form and prohibits nothing. Source accounting only: authored_facets unchanged at 1977.
